response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web software developer with strengths in TypeScript, Node.js, and some low-latency backend work in DLang, but the role requires deep expertise in SoC/IP modeling, hardware architecture, AI accelerator performance analysis, and hardware-software co-design. The resume shows no evidence of GPU/SIMD/MIMD architecture work, deep-learning workload optimization, or silicon-level performance engineering, making this a fundamental domain mismatch despite meeting the years-of-experience bar.
strengths: 15+ years of software engineering experience, satisfying the BS + 8 years requirement
Some performance-oriented systems experience (low-latency DLang services, async I/O, caching at high request volumes)
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, and teaching/workshop experience
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, hardware architecture, or hardware-software co-design experience
No deep-learning training/inference optimization or GPU/accelerator workload analysis background
Career trajectory is web/product engineering, not principal-level performance architecture for silicon

key_factors.factor: General systems and performance engineering experience
